mapper.select: select room_id from sup_equipment_room where site_id = #{siteId} order by room_id for update
select cabinet_id from sup_equipment_cabinet where site_id = #{siteId} order by cabinet_id for update

select r.server_id as sourceId, r.platform_id as platformId from sup_platform_server_rel r join sup_server s on s.server_id = r.server_id join sup_platform p on p.platform_id = r.platform_id where s.site_id = #{siteId} and p.site_id = #{siteId} order by r.server_id, r.platform_id for update

select r.asset_id as sourceId, r.platform_id as platformId from sup_platform_asset_rel r join sup_hardware_asset a on a.asset_id = r.asset_id join sup_platform p on p.platform_id = r.platform_id where a.site_id = #{siteId} and p.site_id = #{siteId} order by r.asset_id, r.platform_id for update
select dict_value as value, dict_label as label from sys_dict_data where dict_type = 'support_network_env' and status = '0' order by dict_sort, dict_code

select server_id as sourceId, site_id as siteId, 'SERVER' as sourceType, 'SERVER' as assetType, server_name as assetName, server_address as ipAddress, ssh_port as sshPort, os_type as osType, os_username as _legacyUsername, os_password_cipher as _legacyCipher, equipment_room as equipmentRoom, cabinet_no as cabinetNo, rack_u_start as rackUStart, rack_u_end as rackUEnd, status, remark, update_time as _updateTime from sup_server where site_id = #{siteId} order by server_id for update

select asset_id as sourceId, site_id as siteId, 'HARDWARE' as sourceType, asset_type as assetType, asset_name as assetName, ip_address as ipAddress, manage_ip as manageIp, manufacturer, asset_model as assetModel, login_username as loginUsername, network_env as networkEnv, mac_address as macAddress, serial_no as serialNo, owner_org as ownerOrg, owner_contact as ownerContact, channel_count as channelCount, output_type as outputType, terminal_type as terminalType, department as department, use_location as useLocation, switch_level as switchLevel, port_count as portCount, uplink_device as uplinkDevice, vlan_info as vlanInfo, gateway_mode as gatewayMode, gateway_direction as gatewayDirection, gateway_bandwidth as gatewayBandwidth, security_zone as securityZone, login_password_cipher as _passwordCipher, equipment_room as equipmentRoom, cabinet_no as cabinetNo, rack_u_start as rackUStart, rack_u_end as rackUEnd, status, remark, update_time as _updateTime from sup_hardware_asset where site_id = #{siteId} order by asset_id for update

select c.credential_id as credentialId, c.server_id as serverId, c.credential_name as credentialName, c.username, c.password_cipher as cipher, c.update_time as updatedAt from sup_server_credential c join sup_server s on s.server_id = c.server_id where s.site_id = #{siteId} order by c.server_id, c.is_default desc, c.credential_id desc for update

select platform_id as platformId, parent_platform_id as parentPlatformId, platform_name as platformName, platform_level as platformLevel from sup_platform where site_id = #{siteId} order by platform_id for update
